label: DESCRIPTIVE_CROSS_POPULATION_ONLY__NOT_FORMAL_ADJUDICATION
warning: This file is a DESCRIPTIVE, cross-population comparison of the v2-era Phase-14 three-contrast diagnostic and the clean-v3 Phase-14 three-contrast diagnostic. It is NOT a formal adjudication. The two evaluations were run on DIFFERENT frozen populations (v2-era 106 FULL_FIELD/156 components vs clean-v3 103 FULL_FIELD/152 components; different size strata and different hard-tiny/global-empty special sets). No gate is re-adjudicated here; the authoritative clean-v3 adjudication is in phase14_clean_v3_diagnostic_evaluation.json (see §9 report).

clean_v3.status: EXECUTABLE clean-v3 diagnostic population (ruling OPTION B)

frozen_references.note: Tg/Dg are population-dependent GLOBAL references (§4 permits remeasurement for clean-v3).

interpretation: GLOBAL references are stable and population-dependent: Tg rises 0.780822->0.791667, Dg falls 0.652776->0.635917. Both within expected sampling variation of the smaller clean-v3 population.

ORACLE_REGIONAL mode is character-identical across populations (tiny recall 1.0, full-field dice ~0.80-0.82, hard-tiny fully recovered, global-empty fully recovered). The refiner POTENTIAL (Step 1) is preserved and not the limiting factor.

PREDICTED_REGIONAL is the divergent axis. In v2-era, predicted tiny recall (0.890) exceeded global (0.781) giving R=0.50 and a passing Step 2. In clean-v3, predicted tiny recall (0.791667) equals global tiny recall (0.791667), giving R=0.0 and a failing Step 2.
The clean-v3 predicted FULL_FIELD dice (0.418531) is slightly HIGHER than v2-era (0.383905) but still far below the 0.632776 Step-3 threshold; both populations fail Step 3 on Dp.

Because the refiner (Oracle) is intact but the frozen Stage-4D PREDICTED proposal pipeline yields no net tiny-recall gain in clean-v3, the clean-v3 diagnosis is PROPOSAL_BOTTLENECK (proposal supply is the bottleneck), whereas v2-era was PRACTICAL_SIGNAL_INSUFFICIENT (the refined proposal signal, though retained, was still insufficient on dice).
Both populations independently yield phase15_status = NOT_AUTHORIZED. Phase 15 must not be started in this task.
